direct_result: On original 022b, 一刻 and 六刻 occupy different vertical columns in the same horizontal band as the 初限 annotation. Original 024a repeats 一刻/六刻 in a band containing the printed eleven-limit annotation, and 四刻/九刻 in a band containing the twelve-limit annotation.

Therefore a marker y-coordinate alone cannot identify its ke coordinate: the same horizontal band contains two distinct printed ke labels. Left/right lane ownership and the numeric cell relation must be independently established before assigning a limit to a day/ke value.

These three source-native RGB bindings strengthen the original layout evidence beyond 13UI general day-seam continuity. They deliberately do not decide whether the initial marker belongs to one刻, six刻, an interval boundary, or another adjacent numeric lane; those are unresolved interpretations, not certified source readings.
